title: 关于标准模式
text: - Standard mode is the default way of playing Sanctuary of Exile
- It features increased drop rates in relation to vanilla Project Diablo 2 aswell as quality of life changes
- Below you will find changes and new features that were introduced in Standard Mode

title: 暗金物品掉落变更
text: - Unique items ratio has been improved, meaning all unique items drop rate has been increased
- Additionally, bosses, champions, unique and super unique monsters have higher chance to drop a unique

title: 常规掉落率变更
text: - Runes are 5 times less likely to downgrade to lower tier during drop generation in Hell LoD content and T1-T3 maps
- Countness always drops three runes
- Demonic Cube has increased drop rate - 1:5000 in Normal
- Demonic Cube has increased drop rate - 1:3000 in Nightmare
- Demonic Cube has increased drop rate - 1:2500 in Hell
- Larzuk Puzzle Piece has increased drop rate - 1:6000 in Normal
- Larzuk Puzzle Piece has increased drop rate - 1:3000 in Nightmare
- Larzuk Puzzle Piece has increased drop rate - 1:1000 in Hell
- Larzuk Puzzle Box has increased drop rate - 1:12000 in Normal
- Larzuk Puzzle Box has increased drop rate - 1:6000 in Nightmare
- Larzuk Puzzle Box has increased drop rate - 1:2000 in Hell
- Skeleton Key has increased drop rate - 1:100 000 in Hell
- Horadrim Navigator has increased drop rate - 1:100 000 in Hell
- Horadrim Almanac has increased drop rate - 1:100 000 in Hell
- Lilith Mirror has increased drop rate - 1:500 000 in Hell
- Vial of the Lightsong has increased drop rate - 1:100 000 in Hell
- WSS in corrupted zones has 1:25 drop rate (from 1:300)
- Unique map drop rate from monsters has increased drop rate to 1:36500
- Unique map drop rate from bosses has increased drop rate to 1:3000
- Twisted essence of suffering drop rate from Normal Andariel is 28% (Quest - 35%)
- Twisted essence of suffering drop rate from Nightmare Andariel is 28% (Quest - 35%)
- Twisted essence of suffering drop rate from Hell Andariel is 28% (Quest - 36%)
- Twisted essence of suffering drop rate from Normal Duriel is 28% (Quest - 35%)
- Twisted essence of suffering drop rate from Nightmare Duriel is 28% (Quest - 35%)
- Twisted essence of suffering drop rate from Hell Duriel is 28% (Quest - 35%)
- Charged Essence of Hatred drop rate from Normal Mephisto is 28% (Quest - 31%)
- Charged Essence of Hatred drop rate from Nightmare Mephisto is 28% (Quest - 31%)
- Charged Essence of Hatred drop rate from Hell Mephisto is 28% (Quest - 31%)
- Burning Essence of Terror drop rate from Normal Diablo is 28% (Quest - 31%)
- Burning Essence of Terror drop rate from Nightmare Diablo is 28% (Quest - 31%)
- Burning Essence of Terror drop rate from Hell Diablo is 28% (Quest - 31%)
- Festering Essence of Destruction drop rate from Hell Baal is 28% (Quest - 31%)
- Festering Essence of Destruction drop rate from Hell Baal is 28% (Quest - 31%)
- Festering Essence of Destruction drop rate from Hell Baal is 28% (Quest - 31%)
- Key of Terror drop rate from Countness and Blood Raven is 29%
- Key of Hate drop rate from Summoner and Bloodwitch is 31%
- Key of Destruction drop rate from Nihlathak and Izual is 29%

title: 超级材料掉落率变更
text: - Rathma Jawbone has increased drop rate in Hell to 1:1300
- Demonic Insignia from Abaddon, Pit of Acheron, Infernal Pit monsters has increased drop rate in Hell to 1:150
- Talisman of Transgression from corrupted zones enemies has increased drop rate to 1:100
- Flesh of Malic from demon enemies has increased drop rate to 1:1300
- Uber Ancients keys in maps have 1:1700 drop rate
- Pure Demonic Essence drop rate from map bosses was increased to ~40%
- Prime Evil Soul drop rate from Hell Mephisto was increased to ~29%
- Prime Evil Soul drop rate from Hell Diablo was increased to ~31%
- Prime Evil Soul drop rate from Hell Baal was increased to ~33%

title: 圣化宝珠
text: - `Sacred Orb` is a currency that creates an imprint of a Runeword
- Please refer to about tab in [Sacreds tab](app:sacreds) for more information
- `Sacred Orb` code is `sror`

title: 神圣宝珠
text: - `Divine Orb` is a currency that allows upgrading `elite` bases to unique item on this base
- `Divine Orb` drops in: T1-T4 maps, from Uber Ancients, from Lucion Chests, from Shadow of Mendeln map event, from Treasure Fallen
- Please refer to [Cube recipes tab](app:cube:Divine Orb) for more information
- `Divine Orb` code is `dvo`

title: 神话宝珠
text: - `Mythic Orb` is a currency that allows upgrading `normal/exceptional` bases to unique item on this base
- `Mythic Orb` drops in: Lord of Destruction content, T1-T4 maps, from Lucion Chests, from Shadow of Mendeln map event, from Treasure Fallen
- Please refer to [Cube recipes tab](app:cube:Mythic Orb) for more information
- `Mythic Orb` code is `mfo`

title: 崇高宝珠
text: - `Exalted Orb` is a currency that allows upgrading `normal/exceptional/elite` bases to set item on this base
- `Exalted Orb` drops in: Lord of Destruction content, T1-T4 maps, from Lucion Chests, from Shadow of Mendeln map event, from Treasure Fallen
- Please refer to [Cube recipes tab](app:cube:Exalted Orb) for more information
- `Exalted Orb` code is `exo`

title: 华丽护符
text: - Ornate charms are horizontal 3x1 charms that drop only in maps
- Ornate charms can roll all of the affixes of Grand Charms
- Ornate charms have exclusive tier of affixes with higher values than obtainable on other charms
- Ornate charms can be re-rolled with the same Cube recipe as other charms
- Better affixes are available on Ornate Charms the higher the item level is
- Ornate charms code is `cm4`

title: 神话珠宝
text: - Mythical jewels are a new tier of jewels that drop only in maps
- Mythical jewels can roll all of the affixes of regular jewels
- Mythical jewels have exclusive tier of affixes with higher values than obtainable on regular jewels
- Mythical jewels can be re-rolled with the same Cube recipe as regular jewels
- Better affixes are available on Mythical jewels the higher the item level is
- Please refer to [Mythical Jewel Cube Recipes](app:cube:mythical jewel recipes) for cube recipes
- Mythical Jewels code is `mjw`

title: 雇佣兵变更
text: - Act 1 Hell mercenaries:
- `Base HP` has been increased by 30% from 900 to 1170
- `HP/lvl` has been increased by 20% from 30 to 36
- `Base defense` increased by 35% from 744 to 1004
- `Defense/lvl` has been increased by 20% from 22 to 26
- `Evade` and `Dodge` passive abilities base levels improved from 5 to 13
- Act 2 Hell mercenaries:
- `Base HP` has been increased by 25% from 1430 to 1787
- `HP/lvl` has been increased by 20% from 40 to 50
- `Base` defense increased by 40% from 1027 to 1438
- `Defense/lvl` has been increased by 30% from 28 to 36
- Now have `Combat Reflexes` on base level 15
- Act 3 Hell mercenaries:
- `Base HP` has been increased by 30% from 1006 to 1307
- `HP/lvl` has been increased by 25% from 27 to 34
- `Base defense` increased by 35% from 640 to 832
- `Defense/lvl` has been increased by 20% from 25 to 32
- Now all variants of mercenary use level 12 `Chilling Armor`
- Act 4 Hell mercenaries:
- `Base HP` has been increased by 30% from 1006 to 1307
- `HP/lvl` has been increased by 25% from 27 to 34
- `Base defense` increased by 35% from 640 to 832
- `Defense/lvl` has been increased by 20% from 25 to 32
- Chance to use `Bone Armor` has been increased from 12% to 25%
- Act 5 Hell mercenaries:
- `Base HP` has been increased by 25% from 1422 to 1787
- `HP/lvl` has been increased by 20% from 45 to 54
- `Base defense` increased by 40% from 1027 to 1438
- `Defense/lvl` has been increased by 30% from 28 to 36
- Now have `Iron Skin` on base level 10

title: 永恒硬币
text: - `Eternal Coin` is a new item that does not have use on it's own, but only as a component of few Cube recipes
- Bought from various vendors for `250k`
- Please refer to [Cube recipes tab](app:cube:Eternal Coin) for more information
- `Eternal coin` code is `ncoi`

title: 珠宝匠棱镜
text: - `Jewellers Prism` is a new item that is used to upgrade `magic Mythical and Regular jewels` to `rare`
- Bought from `Anya` for `500k`
- Please refer to [Cube recipes tab](app:cube:Prism) for more information
- `Jewellers Prism` code is `jewp`

title: 基德的奇趣盒
text: - `Gheed's Crafting Box` is a currency that on cubing `twice` will reward the player with random stack of `50x Perfect Gems`
- Drops in A1 - A5 Hell, T1-T4 Maps, Treasure Fallen event, Shadow of Mendeln event
- `Gheed's Crafting Box` code is `gcbx`

title: 恰西的工艺盒
text: - `Charsi's Crafting Box` is a currency that on cubing `twice` will reward the player with random stack of `5x Crafting Infusion`
- Drops in A1 - A5 Hell, T1-T4 Maps, Treasure Fallen event, Shadow of Mendeln event
- `Charsi's Crafting Box` code is `ccbx`

title: 制图师的盒子
text: - `Cartographers's Box` is a currency that on cubing `twice` will reward the player with random stack of `5x Random Glyphs`, `5x Random Chisels` or `5x Catalyst Shard`
- Drops in A1 - A5 Hell, T1-T4 Maps, Treasure Fallen event, Shadow of Mendeln event
- `Cartographers's Box` code is `cabx`

title: 靴子孔数
text: - Boots are now able to have sockets
- `Normal tier boots` can have up to 1 socket
- `Exceptional tier boots` can have up to 2 sockets
- `Elite tier boots` can have up to 3 sockets
- Socketable socketed in boots count as socketed in helmet/chest

title: 怪物变更
text: - Unique non-boss monsters on Hell difficulty damage bonus coefficient increased from 66% to 80%
- Champion monsters damage bonus coefficient increased from 66% to 80%

title: 赌博变更
text: - Class bases are available in gambling
- More bases is available in gambling

title: NPC 变更
text: - Akara now sells Token of Absolution for 1 gold. Finally we may rejoice!

title: 动作速度
text: - A new percentage modifier “+X% to Action Speed” that affects:
- Total run/walk speed (multiplicatively)
- Reduces the amount of `+% Increased Attack Speed` player needs to get to the next breakpoint
